name: finance
description: Money — generate scannable SEPA payment QR codes (EPC069-12) to pre-fill a bank transfer (payment-qr), read read-only banking data (balances, transactions, spending) via bank-mcp, and manage shared expenses, groups, friends and balances on Splitwise via splitwise-mcp (the full Splitwise API v3.0). Both servers are self-hosted on the NAS at https://mcp.loup-peluso.com (/bank, /splitwise) behind Cloudflare Access; bank is backed by Enable Banking (Revolut) read-only account information, and each server holds its own provider key server-side. Supply the Cloudflare Access service-token credentials to enable.

CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID.title: Cloudflare Access Client ID
CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID.description: The CF-Access-Client-Id for the mcp.loup-peluso.com Access service token (public identifier, ends in .access). Sent as a request header so Cloudflare Access lets the request through at the edge.

CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET.title: Cloudflare Access Client Secret
CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET.description: The CF-Access-Client-Secret paired with the Client ID. Stored in your system keychain, never written to the repo; maintainer copy is SOPS-encrypted in secrets/cloudflare-access.sops.json.
